confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate of July 2026 peak-season prices in a Adriatic beach resort, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; hotel and hostel anchors are least certain because July rates vary widely by weekday, event and booking window. Assumes roughly 1 EUR = 1.15 USD. FX observation came from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages and was not opened directly; the 16 October figure cited by a third-party site was unverified and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Italian Adriatic seaside resorts with high summer tourism demand (for example Riccione and Cesenatico), with Rimini's beach-front and historic-centre pricing mixed in. The beer-to-wine and cocktail relationships follow typical Italian resort menus, where cocktails run about twice the beer price and house wine by the glass sits slightly above beer.
